name: mskuibida-tooling
description: Maksym Skuibida's personal Claude Code tooling — small, opinionated plugins.

plugins.name: response-format
plugins.description: A house style for Claude's replies: one self-contained, fully linked, ask-first report at hand-back or when you are needed, quiet mid-flight, decisions through the question UI, and a hard bias against unverified claims.

plugins.name: worktree-cleanup
plugins.description: Find and remove orphaned git worktrees across many repos, gated on unpushed work, live sessions, and recent activity — re-verified at the moment of deletion, not at scan time.

plugins.name: model-fit
plugins.description: Before the first real task of a session, a quick Haiku check asks whether the session model fits it, on four tiers (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus, Fable); on a mismatch you get a Switch or Stay dialog before anything runs. It respects your cap and availableModels setting and, in auto, probes each model once a day; a transient error counts as available.

plugins.name: project-panel
plugins.description: A side pane for any repo with a plan: its sections, their items and what blocks the next one, with progress rings. Providers: AI-DLC v2, and a task ledger (WORKPLAN.md) read against its pull or merge requests (GitHub through gh, GitLab through glab, self-hosted included), with each pull request's review state and what it asks of you. Opens with /panel.

plugins.name: ask-guard
plugins.description: Keeps the question dialog readable: a question the model writes longer than 250 characters (configurable) is sent back with word to put the context in a markdown message first and ask in one line. Other plugins' dialogs pass untouched.
